item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Mainly clear and chilly tonight
item.description: Mainly clear skies and a chilly night's ahead. An Extreme Cold Warning is going up for the eastern Santa Clara hills and a Cold Weather Advisory for Bay Area valleys, hills and mountains tomorrow morning from 1 a.m. to 9 a.m. Temperatures will range from the mid 20s to the mid 30s.

item.title: Unknown petroleum product causing blackouts in Burlingame as businesses continue to struggle
item.description: Even though PG&E provided generators for those impacted, businesses were told they had to hire a private electrician to do checks before the utility company would hook them up.

item.title: Cause of death for swimmer found in Santa Cruz County beach revealed by coroner
item.description: Erica Fox disappeared December 21, during a group swim off Lovers Point in Pacific Grove.

item.title: Santa Clara Co. Rapid Response Network condemns ICE violence after Minnesota shooting
item.description: Members of the Santa Clara County Rapid Response Network condemn the violence they saw in Minnesota and similar issues they've seen locally as well.

item.title: For cancer patients, music is mental medicine
item.description: The Melody Study paired patients up with music therapists for a seven-week trial.

item.title: Minneapolis ICE shooting: Tensions flare after ICE officer kills woman
item.description: State and local officials demanded ICE leave the state after 37-year-old Renee Nicole Macklin Good was shot in the head.

item.title: Newsom punched back at California critics in his final State of the State speech
item.description: California Gov. Gavin Newsom said the state must stand up to Republican President Donald Trump's "assault on our values," warning democracy is at stake in his final State of the State address Thursday.

item.title: 'Felt like an earthquake': Sonoma Co. still cleaning up after storms topple trees, wash away roads
item.description: In the North Bay, big repairs and major clean-up jobs are happening in communities along the Russian River, where storms over the past two weeks toppled trees and washed away roads.

item.title: 5 states, including CA, sue Trump administration for withholding billions in social safety net funds
item.description: California and four other states have sued the Trump administration for freezing billions in federal aid for child care and low-income programs, calling the move unconstitutional.

item.title: Large crowd gathers for anti-ICE vigil in Pleasanton following shooting of Renee Good
item.description: More than 100 people came out for a vigil at Delucchi Park in Pleasanton to mourn Renee Good, the 37-year-old mother of three, who was fatally shot by ICE agents in Minneapolis on Wednesday.
